title: Oil Prices Fall as Trump Cancels Iran Strikes
subtitle: Global markets react to hopes for a new diplomatic deal in the Middle East

summary.en: Global oil prices dropped sharply on Monday after Donald Trump cancelled planned military strikes against Iran. The President claims that Iran and other nations are ready to negotiate a deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. Despite this optimism, Tehran has denied that any formal talks are scheduled to begin. Meanwhile, European and American stock markets have shown signs of recovery. Analysts remain cautious about whether these diplomatic hopes will actually lead to a lasting peace.
summary.zh: 在川普宣布取消原定對伊朗的軍事打擊後，全球油價於週一大幅下跌。總統聲稱伊朗與其他國家已準備好協商協議，以重新開放荷莫茲海峽。儘管抱持樂觀態度，德黑蘭方面已否認有任何正式談判預定展開。與此同時，歐美股市已出現復甦跡象。分析師對於這些外交希望是否真能帶來持久和平仍持謹慎態度。

paragraphs.en: Global financial markets saw a positive shift on Monday as oil prices fell and stock markets rose. This change followed an announcement by Donald Trump that he had cancelled planned military strikes against Iran. The President stated that he made this decision because Iran and other Middle Eastern countries asked for more time to negotiate a deal. According to The Guardian, this proposed agreement aims to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, a vital shipping passage, and end Iran’s nuclear threat.
paragraphs.zh: 週一全球金融市場出現正面轉變，油價下跌而股市上揚。此一變化源於川普 (Donald Trump) 宣布取消原定對伊朗的軍事打擊。這位總統表示，他做出此決定是因為伊朗及其他中東國家要求更多時間來協商協議。根據《衛報》(The Guardian) 報導，這項擬議中的協議旨在重新開放重要的航運通道荷莫茲海峽，並終結伊朗的核武威脅。

paragraphs.en: Following the news, the price of oil dropped significantly. Brent crude, a standard measure for oil prices, fell by 5% to $83.47 a barrel by midday. Earlier in the day, it had dropped even further. This is a major change from July, when oil prices jumped by more than 20% due to rising tensions and attacks on oil tankers in the region. These attacks created fears about the safety of ships moving through the important waterway, which is why the sudden drop in price is seen as a relief for global markets.
paragraphs.zh: 消息傳出後，油價顯著下跌。作為油價基準的布蘭特原油，在中午時分下跌了百分之五，來到每桶八十三點四七美元。當天稍早，跌幅甚至更深。這與七月的情況相比有重大轉變，當時由於區域緊張局勢升高以及油輪遇襲，油價曾飆漲超過百分之二十。這些攻擊引發了對船隻行經該重要水道安全性的擔憂，這也是為何油價突然下跌被視為全球市場的一大緩解。

paragraphs.en: While the President claimed that talks would begin on Monday, officials in Tehran have denied this statement. This disagreement highlights the uncertainty surrounding the situation. Tony Sycamore, a market analyst at the investment platform IG, noted that the main question is whether this week will see the same problems as last week. He warned that hopes for a deal could collapse if Iran continues to use its control over the strait to pressure the United States, perhaps through further attacks on tankers or military bases.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管總統聲稱談判將於週一展開，但德黑蘭的官員已否認此說法。這種分歧凸顯了局勢周遭的不確定性。投資平台 IG 的市場分析師湯尼·賽卡摩爾 (Tony Sycamore) 指出，主要問題在於本週是否會重演上週的困境。他警告，如果伊朗繼續利用其對海峽的控制權來向美國施壓，例如透過進一步攻擊油輪或軍事基地，那麼達成協議的希望可能會破滅。

paragraphs.en: For many families, the recent rise in oil prices has been a difficult experience. According to the RAC, a motoring group in the UK, fuel prices continued to climb over the weekend. Petrol reached a record high of 160.85p a litre on Monday, while diesel prices also rose. Simon Williams, the head of policy at the RAC, explained that fuel prices have risen sharply since early July. He noted that while prices at the pump should start to become more stable this week, diesel could still reach 185p in the coming days.
paragraphs.zh: 對許多家庭而言，近期油價上漲是一段艱難的經歷。根據英國汽車組織英國皇家汽車俱樂部 (RAC) 的數據，燃料價格在週末持續攀升。週一汽油價格達到每公升一百六十點八五便士的歷史新高，柴油價格也隨之上漲。該組織的政策負責人賽門·威廉斯 (Simon Williams) 解釋說，燃料價格自七月初以來急劇上漲。他指出，雖然加油站的價格本週應會開始趨於穩定，但柴油價格在未來幾天仍可能達到一百八十五便士。

paragraphs.en: Despite the ongoing uncertainty, the news of cancelled strikes has brought some calm to the stock markets. Kathleen Brooks, a research director at the broker XTB, said that lower oil prices will help ease fears about inflation, which is the general rise in the price of goods and services. She added that this could also help bond yields, which are the returns investors get from government loans. These yields had reached their highest levels in 19 years last week, causing concern among investors. In response to the latest developments, European shares rose, and US stock futures suggested a positive start for Wall Street.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管不確定性持續存在，但取消軍事打擊的消息為股市帶來了一些平靜。經紀商 XTB 的研究總監凱瑟琳·布魯克斯 (Kathleen Brooks) 表示，油價下跌將有助於緩解對通貨膨脹（即商品與服務價格普遍上漲）的擔憂。她補充說，這也可能對債券殖利率（即投資人從政府貸款中獲得的回報）有所幫助。這些殖利率上週達到了十九年來的最高水準，引起投資人憂慮。針對最新發展，歐洲股市上漲，美國股指期貨也顯示華爾街將有正面開局。

paragraphs.en: On the ground, the situation remains complex. Shipping data shows that while some tankers carrying Saudi oil have successfully passed through the Bab el-Mandeb strait, traffic in the Strait of Hormuz has slowed down. This is partly due to reports of vessel attacks. The United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations Centre has reported three more attacks on tankers since Saturday. Additionally, the oil cartel known as Opec+—a group of countries that work together to control oil production—agreed to increase the amount of oil they produce by about 188,000 barrels a day starting in September. This move is intended to help balance the market, though experts say that current export problems might limit the effect of this decision.
paragraphs.zh: 在實地層面上，情況依然複雜。航運數據顯示，雖然一些載運沙烏地阿拉伯石油的油輪已成功通過曼德海峽，但荷莫茲海峽的交通已放緩。這部分是因為有船隻遇襲的報導。英國海事貿易行動中心自週六以來已通報另外三起針對油輪的攻擊事件。此外，被稱為「石油輸出國組織與結盟油國」(Opec+) 的石油卡特爾——一個合作控制石油產量的國家組織——同意從九月開始，將每日石油產量增加約十八萬八千桶。此舉旨在協助平衡市場，儘管專家表示，目前的出口問題可能會限制這項決定的效果。

paragraphs.en: As the week continues, the world is watching closely to see if the promised talks will actually take place. While the cancellation of military strikes has provided a temporary boost to the economy, the underlying conflict remains unresolved. Whether this leads to a real diplomatic breakthrough or just another period of tension remains to be seen. For now, investors and motorists alike are waiting for clearer signs that the situation in the Middle East is truly moving toward a peaceful solution.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著本週持續進行，全球正密切關注承諾的談判是否真的會舉行。雖然取消軍事打擊為經濟提供了暫時的提振，但根本衝突仍未解決。這是否會帶來真正的外交突破，還是僅是另一段緊張時期的開始，仍有待觀察。目前，投資人和駕駛人都在等待更明確的跡象，以確認中東局勢是否真的正朝向和平解決方案邁進。

quiz.question: According to the article, what specific action did Opec+ take to address the current oil market situation?

options.A: They decided to stop all oil exports from the Strait of Hormuz.
options.B: They agreed to increase daily oil production by approximately 188,000 barrels.
options.C: They lowered the price of Brent crude to $83.47 per barrel.
options.D: They signed a diplomatic agreement with the United States to end the conflict.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第六段，文中明確指出 Opec+ 同意從九月開始，每天增加約 188,000 桶的石油產量，目的是平衡市場。選項 A 與文意不符，因為文中並未提到停止出口；選項 C 錯誤，因為 83.47 美元是 Brent 原油的價格，而非 Opec+ 的決策；選項 D 則完全未在文中提及，屬於無中生有的錯誤選項。

quiz.question: What can be inferred about the relationship between the Strait of Hormuz and global oil prices?

options.A: The Strait of Hormuz has no impact on global oil prices.
options.B: When the Strait of Hormuz is considered unsafe, oil prices tend to decrease.
options.C: Instability in the Strait of Hormuz often leads to higher costs for consumers.
options.D: The United Kingdom is the only country affected by price changes in the Strait of Hormuz.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。文章第二段提到，七月時因油輪遇襲導致對該航道安全產生疑慮，造成油價上漲 20%；第四段則提到油價上漲對家庭造成負擔。由此可推論，該航道的不穩定性會引發市場恐慌並推升油價。選項 A 與文意相反；選項 B 錯誤，因為不安全感會導致價格上漲而非下跌；選項 D 過於武斷，文章雖提到英國，但並未說僅有英國受影響。

quiz.question: In the fifth paragraph, what does the word 'ease' mean in the context of 'ease fears about inflation'?

options.A: To reduce or lessen the intensity of something.
options.B: To move something slowly and carefully.
options.C: To provide physical comfort to someone.
options.D: To make a task easier to complete.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。在此語境中，'ease fears' 指的是減輕或緩和對通貨膨脹的擔憂。選項 B 雖然有「緩慢移動」之意，但不符合此處抽象名詞的用法；選項 C 的「舒適」通常用於身體感受，而非情緒或憂慮；選項 D 雖有「使容易」之意，但在此處並非指完成任務，而是指降低恐懼的程度，故 A 最為精確。

quiz.question: What is the primary focus of this article?

options.A: A detailed history of the conflict between the United States and Iran.
options.B: The technical process of how oil is transported through the Strait of Hormuz.
options.C: The impact of geopolitical tensions and cancelled military strikes on global financial and oil markets.
options.D: A guide for investors on how to profit from fluctuating oil prices.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。整篇文章從美伊衝突的緩解（取消空襲）切入，隨後討論了此事件對油價、股市、通貨膨脹及市場情緒的影響。選項 A 僅是背景，非文章核心；選項 B 僅在第六段提到數據，並非全文主旨；選項 D 並非文章目的，文章僅是報導市場現況，並未提供投資建議。
